notes.title: Anima Reprise 1 Year Anniversary!
notes.notes:
Hello one and all! It is I, the Witch, back from the depths of my music cave here to celebrate the 1 year anniversary of Anima Reprise! It's crazy isn't it? The year went by so fast. . . I still can't believe how far I've come on my game development and music composition journey, and I am excited to show whatever I may do next! But for now, happy birth day Anima Reprise! And don't forget to clean out your attic of clowns! I know I still have a few skeletons in there. . .
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840990/9b7175db35d343f498ceb552b56923a8c2351662.png[/img]
(Pst, this art was done by the amazing Ripjaw! He did all of the original promotional art too)

PS: There is a Spanish Translation that is entering the final phases of production! I can't wait for more people to be able to enjoy the game in a new language.

(PPS: The game did not originally release on steam first, so that is why the dates don't line up)
